note: Every required item needs a person's recorded sign-off before anything is published. Only a human edits 'signoff' (python packaging/release_gate.py sign ...). Green CI does not satisfy any item. See docs/release-gate.md. Item worldline-spline-review was retired in M16 because the code it covered was removed; the release build must prove that (worldline_spline_free). M17 added source-history-licensing, g2p-model-provenance, ai-code-authorship and native-dependencies-review for the independent reviewer (docs/review/INDEPENDENT-REVIEWER-CHECKLIST.md); g2p-model-provenance records which variant of the build was approved (included/excluded) and the gate refuses the other. M18: the model-free build is the proposed release configuration; a build with the g2p model is internal research only and check --release refuses it.
